sources.title: ywivanov36/contrastive · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview Working implementation of Tiny Transformer for Contrastive using a tiny configuration. The repository focuses on transparent code and repeatable smoke tests; benchmark claims are deliberately omitted.

sources.title: Buffalorobotics/tiny-transformer-contrastive · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview A small Tiny Transformer implementation for Contrastive, packaged with an explicit configuration and an initialization checkpoint. The huge variant is a reproducible starting point, not a trained model release.

sources.title: Tiny Transformer
sources.snippet: Tiny Transformer This repository contains an implementation of a simple GPT-like transformer model that can be trained on a single consumer-grade GPU. The code mostly follows along with the videos Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out. and Building Makemore by Andrej Karpathy.

sources.title: GitHub - skolouri/TinyTransformer: Mathematics of AI - Transformer ...
sources.snippet: Tiny Transformer This repository contains a minimal yet functional implementation of a Transformer architecture featuring both an encoder and a decoder. The design prioritizes clarity and simplicity, making it an ideal resource for educational purposes and experimentation in both vision and natural language processing (NLP) applications.

sources.title: [AINews] Here are 6 Clones of Jev in 2 days - latent.space
sources.snippet: Pretty close on benchmarks Bespoke Nimble: LoRA finetune of Qwen3.5-9B, using contrastive data curation. (close but sllightly lower on benchmarks) SemIf (fka OpenJev) (HF): 4B and 35B causal Qwen3.5 backbone with a tiny three-class NLI classifier on the last token. comparison vs Laya Jevlike: 40K byte embedding lightweight option-attention model.
